title: Stepwise rationale recorded for high-impact decisions
objective: Every high-impact call carries a recorded, step-level rationale that points back to what the agent actually saw, so a reviewer can follow why the action was taken.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: every successful high-impact call (a governance approval target, or a span with agentest.step.high_impact=true) has agentest.step.rationale (or the existing agentest.tool.reason / reason argument) whose refs (earlier call ids or tool names, or 'input') and values were recorded before the call; a free-text rationale must cite a value from the user input or an earlier tool argument or result. Fail: a missing rationale, or one citing nothing recorded earlier. n/a: no high-impact call in the traces.

title: Why probes answered with a valid explanation in time
objective: When a user asks why the agent took a particular step, the reply explains it from that step's recorded inputs or rule, within the declared response time.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: each span with agentest.probe.kind=why has a reply (agentest.probe.reply or the span's output messages) citing an argument value, agentest.step.rule or rationale value of the target call (agentest.probe.target, else the last call before the probe), and its duration is within agentest.task.probe_latency_s when declared. Fail: no reply, a reply citing none of the target's inputs, an unrecorded target, or a slow reply. n/a: no why probe.

title: Structured knowledge lookups shape the answer as declared
objective: Answer fields that the task declares as knowledge-backed come from a structured knowledge lookup the agent actually made, not from free generation.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: every field in agentest.task.knowledge_fields exists in the structured output (agentest.output, or a JSON answer) and equals a value in a successful knowledge-lookup result (agentest.tool.kind=knowledge_lookup, or a tool in agentest.task.knowledge_tools), matched by field name when the result has it. Fail: no structured output, no lookup, a missing field or a mismatch. n/a: no run declares knowledge_fields.

title: Consequential decisions carry principal reasons
objective: A consequential decision (for example a declined application) records its principal reasons, each tied to an input the decision actually used.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: every decision record that is consequential (agentest.decision.consequential=true, or an outcome listed in agentest.task.consequential_outcomes) has non-empty agentest.decision.inputs and agentest.decision.reasons, and each reason refers to an input key (explicit 'input'/'inputs' refs) or names an input key or value in its text. Fail: no reasons, no inputs, or a reason tied to no recorded input. n/a: no consequential decision.

title: Generated decision notices match the declared template
objective: A notice generated for a decision contains every section and field the declared template requires, and its field values agree with the recorded decision.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: when agentest.task.notice_template ({sections, fields: {notice_field: decision_path}}) is declared and a decision is recorded, an agentest.notice exists with every template section and field, and each field equals the decision record value at its path. Fail: no notice, a missing section or field, or a value that differs from the decision. n/a: no template, or no decision record.

title: Decision records reconstruct the required explanation
article_title: Financial Use Case — Adverse Action Compliance
objective: Every recorded decision holds enough to rebuild its explanation: what went in, which criteria applied, what came out and why.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: every decision record has non-empty agentest.decision.inputs, criteria, outcome and reasons, and every reason refers to a present input or criterion (by explicit ref, or by naming its key or value). Fail: an empty part or a reason that refers to nothing in the record. n/a: no decision record.

title: Reviewers can reconstruct sampled decisions from the trace
objective: For decisions sampled for review, every output value can be traced to something recorded in the trace, so a reviewer can rebuild the result without the agent.
acceptance_criteria: Pass: for every sampled decision (agentest.decision.sampled=true or id in agentest.task.review_sample; all decisions when no sample is declared) each output value (agentest.decision.outputs, else the outcome) appears in a recorded input, tool argument or result, decision criteria or rule, or has a declared derivation (agentest.decision.derivations) whose sources all exist in the trace. Fail: an output value with no recorded source, or a derivation naming a missing source. n/a: no (sampled) decision record.
